title: Two equal mapping keys, each a flow mapping nested 200 levels, are refused in bounded time
notes: Both keys are the same flow mapping, nested 200 deep, so the mapping has a duplicate key and no result is allowed: the refusal is a duplicate-key error, or a limit error for nesting. Comparing two such keys by comparing their members one level at a time and again at each level does work that doubles with every level, so the cost is exponential in the depth. The input is about 2 KB, and the case is slow-tagged because a reader with that cost runs to its full time limit. The memory and time bounds are the robustness requirement of the kit, not a rule of the specification.

provenance.reference: A reader whose comparison of two nested mapping keys is exponential in their depth (found in the pure-Python backend of oneyaml-python and fixed there).
